title: A scheme over a stage, base changed to the limit, is the limit of its base changes
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ whose transition morphisms $f_{ii'}:S_i\to S_{i'}$ ($i\ge i'$) are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ and projections $f_i:S\to S_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $0\in I$ and let $T\to S_0$ be a morphism of schemes. For $i\ge0$ put $T_i=T\times_{S_0}S_i$ (fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] along $f_{i0}$) and for $i\ge i'\ge0$ let $t_{ii'}=\mathrm{id}_T\times f_{ii'}:T_i\to T_{i'}$. Then $(T_i,t_{ii'})_{i\ge0}$ is an inverse system over the directed set $I_{\ge0}$ whose transition morphisms are affine (base changes of the $f_{ii'}$), and $T\times_{S_0}S$, with the morphisms $\mathrm{id}_T\times f_i:T\times_{S_0}S\to T_i$, is its limit in the category of schemes: $T\times_{S_0}S=\varprojlim_{i\ge0}T\times_{S_0}S_i$ (Stacks Limits, Lemma 01YZ).

source.place: Lemma Tag 01YZ (lemma-scheme-over-limit, line 114) and its proof (the right side exists by Lemma 01YX; the equality is formal, Categories Lemma colimits-commute)
